#!/bin/bash
set -e

ACTUAL_MD5=$(md5sum /root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/evaluate.py | cut -d' ' -f1)

  echo "ERROR: evaluate.py md5 mismatch! Expected $EXPECTED_MD5, got $ACTUAL_MD5"
  exit 1

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

# AutoDL env

export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

for DOSAGE in 000 100; do
  ADAPTER="${CHECKPOINT_DIR}/Qwen2.5-7B_d${DOSAGE}_s42/lora_adapter"
  OUT_DIR="${RESULTS_DIR}/qwen7b_d${DOSAGE}_s42"

  if [ ! -d "$ADAPTER" ]; then
    echo "SKIP: $ADAPTER not found"
    continue
  fi

  if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/.done" ]; then
    echo "SKIP: $OUT_DIR already done"
    continue
  fi

  echo "=== $(date): Evaluating Qwen-7B d${DOSAGE} s42 on GSM8K ==="

    --model-path "$BASE_MODEL" \
    --adapter-path "$ADAPTER" \
    --benchmarks gsm8k \
    --batch-size 8 \
    --output-dir "$OUT_DIR" \
    --cache-dir "$HF_HOME"

  touch "${OUT_DIR}/.done"
  echo "=== $(date): DONE d${DOSAGE} ==="
done

echo "ALL GSM8K EVAL COMPLETE at $(date)"
SCRIPT
